queries.sql:
<![CDATA[WITH emp AS (
   SELECT glcc.segment1,
          decode(
             :p_external_flag,
             'N',
             person_type.user_person_type,
             'External Guest'
          ) user_person_type
     FROM per_all_assignments_m paam,
          gl_code_combinations glcc,
          per_person_types_tl person_type
    WHERE 1 = 1
      AND paam.primary_assignment_flag = 'Y'
      AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
      AND paam.primary_flag = 'Y'
      AND paam.effective_latest_change = 'Y'
      AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN paam.effective_start_date AND paam.effective_end_date
      AND glcc.code_combination_id = paam.default_code_comb_id
      AND person_type.person_type_id = paam.person_type_id
      AND person_type.language = 'US'
      AND person_type.source_lang = 'US'
      AND paam.person_id = :p_emp_no
),segment_desc AS (
   SELECT value.description,
          code.flex_value
     FROM fnd_flex_values_tl value,
          fnd_flex_values code
    WHERE 1 = 1
      AND value.flex_value_id = code.flex_value_id
      AND source_lang = 'US'
      AND code.enabled_flag = 'Y'
),user_account_segment AS (
   SELECT lkup.attribute1,
          lkup.attribute2,
          lkup.attribute3
     FROM fnd_lookup_values_vl lkup,
          emp
    WHERE 1 = 1
      AND emp.user_person_type = lkup.description
      AND lkup.lookup_type = 'GCF_TRAVEL_BUDGET_CHECK'
      AND lkup.enabled_flag = 'Y'
      AND lkup.tag = :p_travel_purpose
)
SELECT account.segment_value1 AS funds,
       segment1.description AS funds_description,
       account.segment_value2 AS organization,
       segment2.description AS organization_description,
       account.segment_value3 AS accounts,
       segment3.description AS accounts_description,
       balances.period_name AS budget_period,
       abs(balances.budget_amount - nvl(
          balances.budget_adjustment_amount,
          0
       )) AS initial_budget,
       nvl(
          balances.budget_adjustment_amount,
          0
       ) AS budget_adjustments,
       nvl(
          balances.budget_amount,
          0
       ) AS total_budget,
       nvl(
          balances.commitment_amount,
          0
       ) AS commitments,
       nvl(
          balances.obligation_amount,
          0
       ) AS obligations,
       nvl(
          balances.actual_amount,
          0
       ) AS expenditures,
       nvl(
          balances.funds_available_amount,
          0
       ) AS funds_available_amount,
       c_budget.name
  FROM xcc_budget_accounts account,
       xcc_balances_v balances,
       xcc_control_budgets c_budget,
       emp,
       segment_desc segment1,
       segment_desc segment2,
       segment_desc segment3,
       user_account_segment uas
 WHERE 1 = 1
   AND balances.budget_ccid = account.budget_code_combination_id
   AND balances.control_budget_id = c_budget.control_budget_id
   AND c_budget.budget_chart_of_accounts_id = account.budget_chart_of_accounts_id
   AND account.segment_value1 = emp.segment1
   AND account.segment_value2 = :p_budget_cost_centre
   AND account.segment_value3 IN ( uas.attribute1,
                                   uas.attribute2,
                                   uas.attribute3 )
   AND account.segment_value1 = segment1.flex_value
   AND account.segment_value2 = segment2.flex_value
   AND account.segment_value3 = segment3.flex_value
   AND balances.period_name = :p_period_name]]>
